name: pnl-weighted-consensus
description: PnL-weighted consensus scoring: weighted_score = sum(max(pnl, 1.0) for traders in bucket) / sum(max(pnl, 1.0) for all traders); threshold applied to weighted_pct (0-100), not raw count. Negative PnL clamped to 1.0 baseline. min_consensus_traders=3 floor blocks signals before any % check.

name: pnl-weighted-consensus-scoring
description: detect_consensus accepts optional trader_pnl: dict[str, float]. Weighted score = sum(max(pnl, 1.0) for traders in bucket) / sum(max(pnl, 1.0) for ALL traders). Negative PnL clamped to 1.0 baseline. Without trader_pnl, equal weights → weighted_pct == raw_pct. Signal model stores both raw_consensus_pct and weighted_consensus_pct; thresholds use weighted only.

title: min-consensus-traders-floor
rationale: Prevent 2-trader signals. With 100 top traders spread across dozens of markets, realistic per-market pool is 3-8 traders. Absolute floor of 3 set as min_consensus_traders in settings. Applied before any % threshold in detect_consensus.
